subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the initial board protocol support persisted `mcp-app` widgets now, and if so what authorized descriptor/view contract should clients use to render them?
rationale: This choice defines a new public gateway and persisted-state contract; source review shows no mechanically implied rendering path, so automation cannot safely choose whether to expose, defer, or redesign it.

options.title: Defer MCP-app widgets for v1
options.body: Keep the initial board surface HTML-only and remove the unsupported `mcp-app` public variant until a dedicated rendering contract is reviewed.

options.title: Define an authorized MCP-app view contract
options.body: Add the minimum descriptor or ticketed reconstruction surface, client integration, and compatibility/security tests needed for clients to render MCP-app widgets.

options.title: Adopt a different shared widget abstraction
options.body: Pause this PR’s widget-content contract and align boards with an existing canonical widget rendering surface before exposing new protocol types.

recommendation.title: Defer MCP-app widgets for v1
recommendation.body: Keep the initial board surface HTML-only and remove the unsupported `mcp-app` public variant until a dedicated rendering contract is reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the author’s merged board UI foundation and current dashboard-domain work.
